turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Reese Dunlap, welcome in! Thanks for scheduling a tour with us today.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: So tell me, what's prompting you to look into this now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly our old unit finally gave out last week.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Based on what we've walked through, the total price for this would be $4,200.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's a bit more than I expected, it feels too expensive.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Totally fair, a lot of folks feel that way at first. Let's break down what's included so you can see the value, and I can walk you through financing.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Let's go ahead and schedule this for next week, and I'll follow up tomorrow to confirm everything.
